configuration.startupCommands.descriptio: Commands automatically executed when the terminal starts
configuration.maxHistoryLines.descriptio: Maximum number of history lines kept (applied to xterm scrollback and the session-restore buffer)
configuration.notifications.enabled.desc: Detect OSC notification sequences (OSC 9 / 777 / 99) in terminal output and show VSCode notifications
configuration.notifications.flashBackgro: Flash the terminal (webview) background briefly when an OSC notification is shown
configuration.fontFamily.description: Font family for the terminal and the ACE editor (CSS font-family format)
configuration.fontSize.description: Font size in px for the terminal and the ACE editor
configuration.lineHeight.description: Terminal line height as a multiple of the font size
configuration.editorHeight.description: Height in px of the ACE command editor (input editor) below the terminal
configuration.layout.widthAdjustment.des: Correction factor for character width used when calculating the number of columns. Actual glyph width and xterm's rendered width differ between fonts, so adjust this when changing fonts. Smaller values produce more columns
configuration.layout.heightAdjustment.de: Correction factor for line height used when calculating the number of rows. Adjust when changing fonts. Smaller values produce more rows
